title: Introduction to Physical AI - The Next Frontier in Artificial Intelligence
description: Physical AI represents a paradigm shift in artificial intelligence research, moving beyond purely digital systems to create intelligent agents that can perceive, reason, and act within the physical world. This emerging field combines advances in machine learning, robotics, sensor technology, and control systems to develop systems capable of meaningful interaction with their environment.
